# Preamble

The input data was prepared as follows.

The following code chunk contains code copied from the Seurat [Differential expression testing](https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/de_vignette) vignette.

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratData)
options(timeout = 1000)
InstallData("ifnb")
ifnb <- LoadData("ifnb")
# load the inferred sample IDs of each cell
ctrl <- read.table(url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yelabucsf/demuxlet_paper_code/master/fig3/ye1.ctrl.8.10.sm.best"), head = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
stim <- read.table(url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yelabucsf/demuxlet_paper_code/master/fig3/ye2.stim.8.10.sm.best"), head = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
info <- rbind(ctrl, stim)

# rename the cell IDs by substituting the '-' into '.'
info$BARCODE <- gsub(pattern = "\\-", replacement = "\\.", info$BARCODE)

# only keep the cells with high-confidence sample ID
info <- info[grep(pattern = "SNG", x = info$BEST), ]

# remove cells with duplicated IDs in both ctrl and stim groups
info <- info[!duplicated(info$BARCODE) & !duplicated(info$BARCODE, fromLast = T), ]

# now add the sample IDs to ifnb 
rownames(info) <- info$BARCODE
info <- info[, c("BEST"), drop = F]
names(info) <- c("donor_id")
ifnb <- AddMetaData(ifnb, metadata = info)

# remove cells without donor IDs
ifnb$donor_id[is.na(ifnb$donor_id)] <- "unknown"
ifnb <- subset(ifnb, subset = donor_id != "unknown")
```

The following code chunk contains in-house code to save key information (count matrix, cell metadata, gene metadata) to files that are used as input for this lesson.

```{r}
library(DropletUtils)
library(tidyverse)
DropletUtils::write10xCounts(path = "data/ifnb.h5", x = LayerData(ifnb, "counts"), type="hdf5")
write_tsv(x = ifnb[[]] |> rownames_to_column("barcode"), file = "data/ifnb_coldata.tsv")
```

# Setup

Run the chunks in order. This notebook uses a course RDS file; update the path
below if your data are elsewhere. The analysis compares reporter-positive and
reporter-negative cells across three paired pools.

```{r}
library(DropletUtils)
library(muscat)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Import data

```{r}
# Count matrix
sce <- read10xCounts(samples = c("ifnb" = "data/ifnb.h5"), col.names = TRUE)
# Cell metadata
# - Converting relevant columns to factor type
coldata <- read_tsv("data/ifnb_coldata.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
    mutate(across(c(orig.ident, stim, seurat_annotations, donor_id), as.factor)) |>
    column_to_rownames("barcode")
colData(sce) <- as(coldata[colnames(sce), ], "DataFrame")
rm(coldata)
sce
```

Inspect the gene metadata.

```{r}
rowData(sce)
```

Inspect the sample metadata.

```{r}
colData(sce)
```

How many cells from each condition (i.e. stimulation)?

```{r}
table(sce$stim)
```

How many cells from each donor?

```{r}
table(sce$donor_id)
```

Sample names can be created by combining donor ID and stimulation (in whichever order).

```{r}
sce$sample_id <- as.factor(paste0(sce$stim, sce$donor_id))
```

How many samples? How many cells from each sample?

```{r}
message(sprintf("Number of samples: %i", nlevels(sce$sample_id)))
table(sce$sample_id)
```

# Analysis

Prepare the SCE object.

```{r}
sce_muscat <- prepSCE(sce, 
    kid="seurat_annotations", # subpopulation assignments
    gid="stim",  # group IDs (ctrl/stim)
    sid="sample_id",   # sample IDs (ctrl/stim.1234)
    drop=TRUE)
sce_muscat
```

Inspect the `experiment_info` entry in the metadata of the object.

```{r}
metadata(sce_muscat)$experiment_info
```

Inspect the cell metadata in the object.

```{r}
colData(sce_muscat)
```

Aggregate the counts into pseudobulks.

```{r}
pb <- aggregateData(sce_muscat,
    assay="counts", fun="sum",
    by=c("cluster_id", "sample_id"))
pb
```

Each cell type is represented by a separate assay in the object.

```{r}
assayNames(pb)
```

Inspect the first few genes in the first pseubodulk matrix for the first cell type.

```{r}
t(head(assay(pb)))
```

Visualise a multidimensional scaling plot of the pseubobulks.

```{r}
(pb_mds <- pbMDS(pb))
```

Perform pseudobulk differential state analysis on the pseudobulks between conditions.

```{r}
res <- pbDS(pb, verbose=FALSE)
names(res)
```

The table of results is the first element of the resulting object.

```{r}
tbl <- res$table[[1]]
# one data.frame per cluster
names(tbl)
```

View results for the first cell type.

```{r}
ct1 <- tbl[[8]]
head(format(ct1[, -ncol(ct1)], digits=2))
```
